title: Player ratings v5: structural audit of the v4 impact - power-play-creating penalty units, penalty value and shrinkage, finishing and on-ice goals in IMPACT - pre-declared rules
declared_at_note: corrected after the runs to the commit time of this file (b2ffe917, 2026-10-02T22:36:40-05:00); the first version carried a mistyped 05:30Z. Nothing else in the file changed. Tuning started after the commit; the holdout look ran at 03:44Z (out/v5_look_log.jsonl).
declared_before: any v5 scoring on the tuning (2019-23), dev (2023-24, 2024-25) or holdout (2025-26) seasons and any v5 sanity table. Run before this file (descriptive, no model comparison on any outcome): (1) the Rantanen audit on the 2026-27 season-start state (D90-weighted box rates, recency bands, linemates, SPM decomposition, impact components); (2) his penalties from the lake PBP vs the NHL stats API season totals 2015-26 (exact match: taken, minors, majors, misconducts, drawn); (3) league power-play-creating units, PP / SH goals and the goal value per unit for every season 2014-26 vs the NHL team power-play report (units within ~2% of official PP opportunities, PP / SH goals within 2); (4) the v5 box caches rebuilt with the new columns (the v4 columns identical in every season).
why: owner (2026-10-03): v4 passes 19 / 21 sanity checks; both failures are Mikko Rantanen (IMPACT +0.6 goals / 82, ~245th). Do not tune anything to move one player: audit the structure of the impact and fix what is wrong, test-gated. Audit findings that define this file: coincidental / offsetting minors were counted as power-play units (about 20% of all penalties) and the goal value per unit (0.153) had them in its denominator and left out PP goals scored with the goalie pulled; drawn and taken shared one shrinkage; EV finishing (FIN) is already in off_impact (EV minutes x FIN) but was never tested as part of IMPACT; PP finishing and on-ice goals are not used.
base: ratings v4 as shipped (v4_prereg.json, out/v4_validation.json): EV OFF / DEF and PP / PK RAPM with the SPM prior, D90 recency, FIN prior 30 xG, expected TOI, impact = goals per 82 above the position average. NOTHING in the RAPM, the SPM (its pd_all / pt_all features stay in v4 units), FIN, TOI, recency or the lineup / simulator inputs changes in this pass: every component below is an impact-only term, so the stint metric of v4 is unchanged by construction (checked: the rebuilt pack's live o / d / pp / pk / fin / toi columns must equal the committed v4 table's).

seasons.holdout_rule: one look after all dev results are written: every component's selected configuration and its reference scored in the same run, logged in bu/rapm/out/v5_look_log.jsonl; no parameter or rule change after it; reported whatever it is

P1_penalty_units.definition: box.pp_units: at each stoppage (game, period, game second) the two teams' penalty minutes (2 / 4 / 5-minute penalties incl. fighting; misconducts, game misconducts, penalty shots 0) cancel minute for minute; the team with more minutes is shorthanded for the excess, shared over its penalties at the stoppage in proportion to their minutes; a minor following a goal of the other team at the same second (washed-out delayed penalty) counts 0. Units are 2-minute minor equivalents; per player-game columns pdu_all (drawn) / ptu_all (taken).
P1_penalty_units.rule: definitional (the impact multiplies units by a goal value per unit, so both must count the same events): the impact's penalty rates use pdu_all / ptu_all. Reported, not a gate: the predictive comparison of the v4-unit rates (rescaled to the PP-unit level by position group) vs the PP-unit rates on next-30-game PP units (Poisson deviance and the net-differential MSE below).

P2_penalty_value.definition: box.pp_goal_value value_pp: (PP goals - shorthanded goals, manpower net of an extra attacker, penalty shots and shootouts excluded) / power-play-creating units, all lake games with TOI rows of the last completed season (regular season + playoffs, as v4)
P2_penalty_value.rule: replaces v4's value (0.1527 for 2025-26) - same rule, corrected definition

P3_penalty_shrinkage.model: drawn and taken rates per 60 all-situation minutes, D90-weighted (unchanged), shrunk to the position-group rate with SEPARATE pseudo minutes t0_d (drawn) and t0_t (taken)
P3_penalty_shrinkage.selection: per kind, the lowest pooled tuning-season Poisson deviance of the next 30 games' PP units (v4_validate.pen_scores machinery: as-of points 0..50 games, regular-season games, rate x his all-situation minutes in the window)
P3_penalty_shrinkage.ship_rule: the selected (t0_d, t0_t) replace (400, 400) if the dev pooled deviance (drawn + taken, PP-unit target) is lower than (400, 400)'s on the same target; holdout reported - if worse than (400, 400) by more than 2 SE (players-clustered), the export keeps 400 / 400 and the owner decides
secondary: next-season deviance (season-start rates scored on the whole next regular season) per kind and t0
net penalty differential MSE: per player and window, (pdu - ptu) actual vs (pd60 - pt60) x minutes / 60 predicted, next-30-game windows and next season, v5 vs v4 (v4 units, t0 400, rescaled by group)

repeatability: split-half (odd / even games within a season) reliability of PP-unit drawn / taken per 60 for players with >= 500 all-situation minutes, season-to-season correlation for players with >= 500 minutes in both, and the empirical-Bayes t0 they imply; all seasons 2014-26, descriptive

C1_ev_fin_in_impact.question: should EV FIN (goals above xG per 60 from own shots, the shipped FIN) stay in off_impact?
C1_ev_fin_in_impact.metric: next-30-game EV stint GOALS MSE: v3_validate windows and scoring unchanged except the target (the same EV rows, weights and covariates with y = the attacking side's goals per 60; covariates refit on the test rows; date-clustered paired SEs); players fixed at the as-of v4 ratings

candidates.E1: o + FIN (the as-of FIN of v4: D90 sums, prior 30 xG, the player's position group)

C1_ev_fin_in_impact.rule: keep FIN in off_impact if E1's dev pooled goal MSE < E0's (paired) and its holdout is not worse than E0 by more than 2 SE; otherwise off_impact drops FIN (the fin column stays as a displayed rate)

C2_pp_fin_in_impact.question: add PP finishing x PP minutes to off_impact?
C2_pp_fin_in_impact.definition: fin_pp = (mult - 1) x shrunk PP ixG / 60, shrunk ixG / 60 = (X_pp + VOL_PSEUDO_S mu_pp) / (S_pp + VOL_PSEUDO_S) x 3600 (finishing.VOL_PSEUDO_S, mu_pp = position group's PP ixG per PP second), X = ixG x the season's league goals-per-ixG ratio of that state; variants: 'own' mult = (G_pp + P) / (X_pp + P); 'shared' mult = (G_ev + G_pp + P) / (X_ev + X_pp + P); D90 weights on the box score (pre-season + in season up to d - 2)
C2_pp_fin_in_impact.metric: next-30-game PP stint GOALS MSE (PP rows of v3, y = PP side's goals per 60), PP skaters' beta = v4 pp + fin_pp, PK skaters at v4 pk
C2_pp_fin_in_impact.selection: lowest pooled tuning-season PP goal MSE among the 8 grid points and 'none' (v4 pp only)
C2_pp_fin_in_impact.ship_rule: if the selection is not 'none': off_impact += 82 x PP minutes / 60 x (fin_pp - position mean) when its dev pooled PP goal MSE < 'none' (paired) and the holdout is not worse by more than 2 SE

C3_onice_goal_blend.question: should EV impact put a small weight on actual on-ice GF / GA (goals above xG)?
C3_onice_goal_blend.model: residual RAPM: the v3 two-stage engine (D90, stage-1 pre-season fit + in-season ridge, d - 2) on the EV rows with target (goals - xG) per 60, prior mean 0 (no roles, no aging, no SPM), prior variance v_r for OFF and DEF; o_res / d_res = each player's on-ice goals-above-xG impact (for / against). The ridge sets the weight on actual goals (a small v_r = a small weight).
C3_onice_goal_blend.metric: C1's next-30-game EV stint goals MSE with beta = base + (o_res, d_res)
C3_onice_goal_blend.selection: lowest pooled tuning-season goal MSE among the 8 candidates
C3_onice_goal_blend.ship_rule: ev_off / ev_def in the impact add o_res / -d_res (x k EV minutes, as the xG terms) only if the selected candidate's dev pooled goal MSE is lower than C1's winner (paired) and its holdout is not worse by more than 2 SE; the displayed ev_off / ev_def stay the xG ratings

impact_formula_v5: v4's impact with: penalty rates in PP units with t0_d / t0_t (P1, P3) and value_pp (P2); FIN term per C1; + 82 PP/60 (fin_pp - m) per C2; + 82 k EV/60 [(o_res - m) + (-(d_res) - m)] per C3. Everything is still goals per 82 games above the position average, drawn in off_impact, taken in def_impact.
export: player_ratings.json stays version 4 (columns appended, never reordered or removed; new impact.* keys), documented in pipeline/CONTRACT.md; the bundle's v4 table gains the new rate columns; lineup / game model / simulator inputs unchanged (o, d, pp, pk, fin, toi), so per the owner rule the simulator is not re-tested unless they change

sanity_checks.status: the v4 CHECK LIST unchanged (21 checks: MacKinnon, McDavid, Draisaitl, Kucherov, Matthews, Pastrnak, Rantanen, Makar, Q. Hughes top 50; Rantanen above Kiviranta / Faksa / Back; those three below DAL's median; Robertson, Johnston, Rantanen, Heiskanen, Hintz, Harley in DAL's top 8), evaluated once on the shipped v5 export and on v4, reported pass / fail as is; plus DAL roster, league top 30 and Rantanen / Makar / Kiviranta / Gallagher / Caufield.
